findings: Matches the main portrait identity: block-built white floating head, black recessed narrow eyes, bright blue downturned brows, faceted cyan/blue crystals.
Preserved all 4265 source triangles, UV seams and provider custom normals; analysis-only graph identifies 13 rigid islands for weights.

Rear and top white-block construction are inferred by Tripo because the design sheet supplies no independent turnaround.
Crystal placement and small surface bevels are approximate, with some source asymmetry retained; no second paid generation was justified.
The GLB faces +Z; the production model wrapper applies a 180-degree yaw to align with the semantic -Z forward.
